results: Actual multiplication by EVERY original complex H-minus-one potential is compact from the ENTIRE original H1 domain into original H-minus-one. The proof uses the already-verified continuous full H-minus-one multiplication family,the norm-closed compact-operator locus,and genuine finite-Fourier density. Each finite approximation is identified with the SAME original distribution as an r=0 endpoint input;no endpoint regularity is assumed of the limit.

For EVERY original complex H-minus-one q and EVERY complex spectral parameter,the normalized full original H1-to-H-minus-one pencil is identity plus compact and Fredholm of index ZERO. Its kernel is exactly the original full-domain eigen-equation,and injectivity implies full physical bijectivity.

The original full H-minus-one spectrum consists exactly of ACTUAL original H1 eigenvalues. The explicit form bound proves that the entire half-plane Re(z)<-singularHillLowerBoundConstant(norm(q)) lies in the full resolvent. In particular,a concrete resolvent point -singularHillLowerBoundConstant(norm(q))-1 is CONSTRUCTED for EVERY original complex H-minus-one q;nonempty resolvent is not a caller premise.

The full original operator graph and partial-linear-map realization are closed for EVERY original H-minus-one q. Actual spectral points transport to nonzero eigenvalues of the ACTUAL compact base resolvent,so every bounded complex spectral region contains only finitely many physical eigenvalues. Real original potentials have entirely REAL actual spectrum. The full spectrum agrees EXACTLY with every earlier endpoint realization.

For ALL original complex H-minus-one potentials,every finite physical root-chain level and the FULL original algebraic root space equal corresponding generalized eigenspaces of any ACTUAL compact resolvent. Full root spaces are finite dimensional,attained at a finite chain length,and stabilize. Actual algebraic multiplicity is the full physical root-space dimension and is positive EXACTLY on the physical spectrum;it agrees literally with the earlier endpoint multiplicity.

The ACTUAL Riesz projection for arbitrary original H-minus-one potentials is a compact finite-rank idempotent on original H-minus-one. Every enclosed physical eigenvector is fixed and every exterior one annihilated. For real q its range is exactly the sum of ALL enclosed full physical root spaces. A full original H-minus-one norm neighborhood,allowing arbitrary nearby COMPLEX potentials,preserves each valid circle and its ACTUAL projection rank;no endpoint membership is supplied.

The article now defines OriginalHminusOnePotential as its FULL original real,mean-zero,physically period-one H-minus-one domain,and originalIsospectralSet by equality of ALL ACTUAL physical algebraic multiplicities at every complex value. Endpoint membership is NOT built into this original type or isospectral set. The original set fixes the entire physical spectrum. For ANY two admissible endpoint orders,its endpoint realizations belong to the SAME original isospectral set IFF their ENTIRE intrinsic canonical label sequences agree.

results: Reused24 shared modules UNCHANGED from the pinned articles/kdv-convexity commit,including the actual H2 coefficient Hill domain,the verified physical constant-upper first-order monodromy criterion,and the entire even-frequency-to-energy discriminant descent. Each copied source hash is verified and every public declaration is privately rebuilt/audited. These236 declarations were already present on the shared branch;they are not counted as newly authored.

hillL2HminusOne realizes every shared complex L2 potential as the SAME original period-two H-minus-one distribution via a bounded complex-linear map. Every normalized coefficient is exactly preserved. Every original H1 vector has an actual absolutely summable coefficient realization with exactly the same original coefficients.

The original full H1/H-minus-one eigen-equation is EXACTLY the existing summable Fourier Hill eigenvector criterion. The shared constructive regularity theorem therefore proves FULL H2,l2 regularity of every original H1 eigenvector at an L2 potential. No stronger H2 membership or infinity-to-l2 substitution is assumed.

singularHillL2EigenvectorLift constructs each H2 eigenvector from the original H1 eigenvector,retains every coefficient,and recovers the ENTIRE original distribution under the original H1 realization. The realization is injective,and existence of nonzero eigenvectors is EXACTLY equivalent on the original H1/H-minus-one and shared H2/L2 domains at EVERY complex energy.

For every complex physically period-one L2 potential,the ACTUAL full original H1/H-minus-one spectrum is EXACTLY hillL2Discriminant(lambda)^2=4. The frequency version at energy z^2 is also proved. The criterion includes zero energy with no division by z,no simplicity or open-gap assumption,and uses the verified constant-upper linear operator comparison for the physical monodromy.

On OriginalHminusOnePotential,the article adapter derives the L2 coefficient even-support condition from the original ENTIRE distribution physical period-one constraint. Any genuine L2 coefficient realization then gives the exact physical energy-discriminant criterion for the ENTIRE original spectrum. No separate parity,spectral table,eigenvector or H2 hypothesis is supplied.
